title: An app you can understand, edit and keep.
description: Run full web apps — frontend and sandboxed backend + SQLite — right in your browser, or host the exact same .softn bundle multi-user inside ZIPP safe-sandbox.

cards.label: What is SoftN?
cards.description: One portable .softn bundle for frontend UI, sandboxed backend code and SQLite data — editable and runnable locally or hosted.

cards.label: Full-Stack Web Containers
cards.description: Run HTML/CSS/JS/TS frontends alongside sandboxed PHP, JS/TS, Rust or Python backends and SQLite in the browser or on softn-server.

cards.label: Build your first SoftN app
cards.description: Make a small change to Fieldnotes, then explore how UI, state and handlers connect inside a portable app.

cards.label: SoftN Builder
cards.description: Design interfaces, scaffold PHP or JS/TS + SQLite container backends, manage SQLite tables and records, and preview live in one workspace.

cards.label: The .softn app format
cards.description: Manifest v2 container fields (backend, databases, frontendRoot), permissions, seeds and how bundles stay portable.

cards.label: Hosting and multi-user sandboxing
cards.description: Run locally in the browser or host multi-user with softn-server — every backend request still runs inside ZIPP safe-sandbox.
